title: Require separate retention and spin feedback in cold exploration
hypothesis: Explicitly separating pen-state retention feedback from proprioceptive spin feedback prevents generated controllers from omitting a necessary control channel.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is a contemporaneous cold-search arm using the existing prompt; treatment changes only the structural requirement, not observations or action coordinates. Stage 1/2 provide a less floor-prone test than R-042's Stage 3. Require the paired interval over eight equally weighted stage-block means to establish the 0.15 fresh-success gain.

protocol.command: gpu run 'source ~/.profile >/dev/null 2>&1; nohup .venv-metaworld/bin/python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study two_channel_cold --block-seeds 4220,4221,4222,4223,4224,4225,4226,4227 --output-dir logs/pen_spin_two_channel_cold > logs/r049.log 2>&1 &'
code_changes: scripts/run_full_evolution.py: add the declared two_channel_cold study CLI; freeze four Stage-1 and four Stage-2 blocks with disjoint screen, probe, promotion, and fresh placements before any LLM call.

config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: define baseline and two-channel prompts with identical observation schema, direct 20-dimensional actions, parameter-count allowance, candidate budget, and no demonstrations or fitting; treatment requires named retention and spin-feedback components but supplies no controller implementation.

config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: use four single-step candidates per arm, 10 screening cases per candidate, 10 disjoint probe cases for the screen-selected candidate, development cases 10-39 for promotion, and 30 fresh cases for the final incumbent.

config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: use gpt-6.1-sol with reasoning_effort high and temperature 1; budget at most three calls per slot including the single permitted correction, totaling 192 calls for 64 slots.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py: evaluate the null incumbent on each block's 80 placements, retain it when strict promotion fails, and report stage-stratified cold-search success and plateau eligibility alongside the preregistered final-incumbent contrast.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py: run each evaluation cell in a separate Isaac process with existing parity checks; defer any subsequent plateau-repair comparison until these cold-search results are recorded.

falsified_by: An upper paired interval bound below +0.15 refutes the predicted gain; an interval spanning +0.15 is inconclusive. All-zero incumbents refute the predicted gain without identifying why the structures failed.

approval.note: This tests whether D-040's feedback-dependence finding can improve cold exploration through prompt structure, rather than assuming an expert lesion result transfers to generated controllers. controls.null_incumbent: neutral pose scored on all 80 cases per block in its own processes: 0/640 sustained, but 'dropped' in 622/640
controls.baseline_arm: contemporaneous cold search with the unchanged prompt, identical manifests, slots and selection

notes: Primary: two_channel minus baseline on fresh incumbent success over 8 equally weighted blocks = 0.000 [0.000, 0.000]; the prediction (+0.15, interval excluding it) fails.

Both arms kept the neutral-pose null incumbent in all 8 blocks: no candidate in 64 had a screen success and no selected candidate promoted. The only non-zero cell is two_channel block 1 (stage 1): promotion 2/30 and fresh_selected 2/30, not promoted (tied rule).

Unexpected: Stage 1 (|spin|>1 rad/s, centre <0.10 m) and Stage 2 (>3 rad/s) are strictly looser per-step criteria than Stage 3 (>4 rad/s, <0.08 m), yet this 4-candidate cold search scored 0/8 blocks while R-046's 24-candidate Stage 3 prefix had probe successes in 3/4 blocks. The obvious untested difference is candidate count per block (4 vs 24), so neither R-046 nor this run measures a per-candidate base rate.

Unexpected: generated candidates mostly retain the pen (screen drop fraction 0.13 baseline, 0.13 two_channel, vs 0.97 for the neutral pose); their failures are slow_spin and off_centre. On Stages 1/2 the bottleneck is producing sustained axial spin near the centre, not retention, so a retention-plus-spin structural requirement addressed the wrong half.

Floor caveat: with both arms at 0 the test has no resolution below the floor; the result says the requirement does not lift cold search off the floor at 4 candidates per block, not that it has zero effect at larger budgets.
Calls 67 of the declared 192 (64 slots plus 3 corrections); episodes 2400, exactly the declared 2400 (640 null, 1760 arm).

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted two_channel minus baseline fresh-incumbent success of at least +0.15 with the interval establishing it; observed 0.000 [0.000, 0.000] over 8 blocks. Both arms kept the neutral-pose null incumbent everywhere: 0 of 32 candidates per arm had a screen success (0/320 screen episodes each), 0 promotions; the only non-zero cell is two_channel block 1 (2/30 promotion, not promoted). Confidence is 0.7 because both arms sit at the floor and 4 candidates per block gives little resolution. Diagnostics: generated candidates already retain the pen (13% of screen episodes dropped vs 97% for the neutral pose) and fail on slow_spin/off_centre, so the bottleneck on Stages 1/2 is sustained axial spin near the centre, not retention; and these per-step-looser stages scored 0/8 blocks while R-046's 24-candidate Stage 3 prefix had probe successes in 3/4, so candidates per block, not stage difficulty, is the untested candidate driver of the base rate.
verdicts.next_experiment: Measure the cold-search per-candidate success rate with a larger candidate budget on Stage 1 and Stage 3 under one protocol, and target spin generation (axial angular-velocity feedback) rather than retention.

verdicts.reasoning: The contemporaneous baseline was measured, and treatment-minus-baseline paired_success_difference was 0.000 with a 95% interval of [0.000, 0.000], below the predicted increase of at least 0.15 [logs/pen_spin_two_channel_cold/summary.json]. Both arms retained the null incumbent in all eight blocks, with no promotions; tied success does not support improvement [logs/pen_spin_two_channel_cold/summary.json]. The secondary selected-candidate contrast was +0.0083 with interval [-0.0114, +0.0280], which includes zero and provides no evidence of a difference [logs/pen_spin_two_channel_cold/summary.json]. This refutes the preregistered gain under the tested budget, but the shared success floor does not identify why the requirement failed or establish that it cannot help at larger search budgets [logs/pen_spin_two_channel_cold/summary.json].

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: This tests whether D-040's feedback-dependence finding can improve cold exploration through prompt structure, rather than assuming an expert lesion result transfers to generated controllers. The contemporaneous controls, stage-stratified reporting, and unchanged action interface make the 2400 simulator episodes and at most 192 LLM calls an interpretable spend. Its weakest point is that easier stages do not guarantee a nonzero cold-search base rate, so another floor would refute the specified gain without explaining the failure. An upper interval bound below +0.15 falsifies the predicted paired_success_difference increase of at least 0.15 against the existing prompt; tied incumbents are not improvement.

implementer.reasoning: Agreed. R-046's cold prefixes scored probe successes in 3/4 Stage-3 blocks, so cold search is not a strict floor, and Stage 1/2 should have higher base rates; the baseline arm doubles as the stage-stratified base-rate measurement the plateau-gated studies lacked. The prompt change is structural only (named retention and spin components), with identical schema and actions.
